messages:
Sam: Heads-up  we need a tiny battlecard + SDR cheat and inbound routing rules for the launch next Tuesday. Focus: clear knockdowns vs CloudX, LLMAPI, InfraCo and routing for benchmark-intent leads.

Elena: I'll draft the 3 battlecard zingers. Recommendation: lead with predictability, then deployment parity, then ops-safe fallbacks. Keep them <=18 words.

Rory: SDR cheat template: 2-line opener, 3 pain/rebut bullets, 2 qualifier Qs, routing tag guidance. I'll sketch and post a quick draft.

Ops: We can do intent tagging + confidence score. Provide patterns and queue names. We can also add a priority field.

Sam: Prototype rules below  tiny and strict to reduce FP:

```
- id: bench_intent
  pattern: ".*benchmark|latency|p50|p75|p95|throughput|cost per token"
  queue: sdr-bench
  priority: 100
- id: enterprise_sla
  pattern: ".*SLA|enterprise|private deployment|VPC|dedicated|reserved"
  queue: ae-enterprise
  priority: 80
- id: compliance
  pattern: ".*on-prem|air-gapped|HSM|HIPAA|SOC 2"
  queue: solutions
  priority: 90
```

bench-bot: benchmark report uploaded (2026-07-08). Highlights: "~19% lower p50 vs CloudX on dedicated pools (quant Q3); p75 improved ~16%; throughput ~1.3x at 4k seq with continuous batching." Methodology: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/2026-july. Add methodology caveat to public claims.

Legal: Use this exact caveat on marketing assets: "Measured on dedicated pools; config: quant Q3; see methodology: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/2026-july". No exceptions.

Elena: Battlecard zingers (v0):
- CloudX: "Broad catalog, but pricing and tail latency can vary at scale." -> Rebut: "Unified runtime + caching/batching to stabilize unit economics and meet latency SLOs."
- LLMAPI: "Nice API, little deployment parity." -> Rebut: "Same API across hosted, dedicated, private with rollout controls and token-level observability."
- InfraCo: "You run infra; you own the ops." -> Rebut: "Managed runtime + migration playbook; optional private control plane for regulated customers."

Rory: SDR cheat excerpt (v0):
Opener: "Redwood Inference: predictable inference economics and one API across hosted, dedicated, private."
Top pains + rebut: "Latency spikes -> batching + cache + fallbacks; Token cost surprise -> unit-econ visibility; No dev-prod parity -> same API across deployments."
Qualifiers: "Are you on reserved/dedicated capacity today? Any p95 targets?"
Routing hint: "Tag lead with 'bench' if they mention latency/cost/throughput."
Caveat: append Legal's exact string at bottom.

Sam: Love it. Action items: @Elena finalize battlecard zingers by 11:00 PT, @Rory finish SDR cheat + quick objection scripts by 12:00 PT, @Ops stage routing and run a 24h replay (FP <3% target). We'll do a final copy pass at 13:00. Thanks :sparkles:
